As suas últimas palavras remetem o grupo para uma comunidade esquecida, que eles acreditam estar a esconder terríveis segredos.

programme.title: A Partida
programme.desc: Ben e a sua melhor amiga Tanner resolvem pregar uma partida à professora de Física que ameaça reprová-los, acusando-a falsamente nas redes sociais do homicídio de um estudante.

programme.title: Prisão 77
programme.desc: Em 1977, na transição para a democracia em Espanha, na prisão Modelo de Barcelona, um jovem contabilista aprisionado por um desfalque, junta-se a um grupo de prisioneiros que exigem uma amnistia geral ao mesmo tempo que procura uma forma de se evadir da prisão.

programme.title: Ainbo - Espírito Da Amazónia
programme.desc: Ainbo é uma jovem heroína que, com os seus guias espirituais, o divertido tatu Dillo e a anta gigante Vaca, embarcam numa viagem para pedir ajuda ao mais poderoso espírito da Amazónia, de forma a salvar a sua casa e a sua comunidade.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: In Memoriam
programme.desc: Harriet é uma reformada com a necessidade de controlar tudo o que se passa à sua volta, incluindo o que virá escrito no próprio obituário. Para isso, contrata uma jovem Anne, para lho escrever ainda em vida para que ela o possa aprovar, o que vai dar origem à mais improvável das amizades.

programme.title: Pelé: O Nascimento De Uma Lenda
programme.desc: Esta é a extraordinária história do lendário jogador de futebol Pelé, desde a sua infância até se tornar no jovem que, aos 17 anos de idade, marcou o golo decisivo na primeira vitória de sempre do Brasil num Campeonato do Mundo, em 1958.

programme.title: Sombras Da Escuridão
programme.desc: Barnabas Collins é um vampiro que, após ter sido enterrado vivo por 196 anos, regressa ao mundo dos vivos e à sua casa ancestral no Maine, onde encontra os seus descendentes absolutamente disfuncionais e a necessitar da sua proteção.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operação Stormbreaker
programme.desc: Após a morte do seu tio, que era um agente secreto e não um bancário como todos supunham, Alex Rider, um estudante de 14 anos, é forçado pela Divisão de Operações Especiais do MI6 a integrar uma missão que poderá salvar milhões de vidas.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: O Cobrador
programme.desc: Um especialista em artes marciais vai trabalhar como cobrador para a mafia, e acaba por ser arrastado por um cliente para uma situação muito mais perigosa que o que ele antecipava.

programme.title: Faz-Te Homem
programme.desc: Quando o milionário James King é condenado à prisão por fraude, o juiz dá-lhe 30 dias para pôr os seus assuntos em ordem e ele pede a Darnell Lewis que o prepare para uma vida atrás das grades. Só que ele não sabe que Darnell é um homem honesto e que vai ter de fingir para o ajudar.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um magnata da tecnologia de Hong Kong é atirada para uma prisão de segurança máxima na Letónia, o especialista em segurança Ray Breslin é contratado para resgatá-la. Só que a namorada dele também é raptada e a missão já de si difícil passa a ser de vida ou de morte.

programme.title: Arqui-Inimigo
programme.desc: Um adolescente encontra um homem misterioso chamado Max Fist, que diz ter perdido os seus super-poderes após chegar à Terra vindo de outra dimensão. Ninguém acredita nele exceto o rapaz, e juntos vão tentar enfrentar um barão do crime e desmantelar o seu negócio de tráfico de droga.

programme.title: Uma Boa Dose De Sexo
programme.desc: Adam, Mike e Neil são três homens que não têm quase nada em comum, exceto serem todos viciados em sexo e estarem em diferentes estágios de recuperação.

programme.title: Traidora Americana: O Julgamento De Axis Sally
programme.desc: Mildred Gillars é uma cantora a atriz americana que transmitiu propaganda nazi aos seus compatriotas durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial. Apelidada de Axis Sally pelos soldados americanos, esta história verídica estende-se à sua captura e ao seu julgamento por traição no pós-guerra.

programme.title: Carrie Pilby
programme.desc: Carrie é uma menina-prodígio de 19 anos, que já se licenciou em Harvard mas que agora está a tentar fugir à sua vida de eremita cumprindo os objetivos de uma lista fornecida pelo seu terapeuta. Só que pelo caminho, ela percebe que a sua visão das relações e da humanidade também se vai alterando.

programme.title: Modernices Do Amor
programme.desc: Em Nova Iorque, uma mulher solteira focada na carreira é forçada a lidar com as consequências de um relacionamento fracassado quando um ex-namorado contrata os serviços da sua empresa.

programme.title: Amesterdão
programme.desc: Na década de 1930, três amigos testemunham um crime, são acusados de o terem praticado acabam por desvendar uma das conspirações mais inacreditáveis da historia dos EUA.

programme.title: A Inspeção
programme.desc: Ellis Fench, um jovem negro e homossexual, rejeitado pela mãe e com poucas opções de futuro, decide alistar-se nos Fuzileiros mas vai ter de sobreviver a todo um sistema que tudo fará para o pôr de lado.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Na sequência do assassínio do Presidente dos EUA John F. Kennedy, a Primeira Dama Jacqueline Kennedy tenta enfrentar a dor e o trauma para recuperar a fé, consolar os filhos e definir o legado histórico do marido.

programme.title: Mercenário: A Redenção
programme.desc: Quando um assassino profissional conhece uma rapariga que foge de um poderoso chefe da máfia politicamente influente, ele vai sentir-se dividido entre proteger a jovem ou permanecer fiel à agência governamental que o contratou.

programme.title: Zona 414
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, numa colónia de robôs humanoides, o detetive particular David Carmichael é contratado para encontrar a filha desaparecida do excêntrico criador dos andróides que integram aquela comunidade.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan ´Jack´ O´Neil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Quo Vadis
programme.desc: No ano 64 d.C., Marcus Vinicius, um comandante romano, apaixona-se por Lygia, uma devota escrava cristã, e começa a questionar a liderança tirânica do despótico imperador Nero.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: Rossini - La Cenerentola
programme.desc: Gioachino Rossini's opera La Cenerentola ('Cinderella'), with a libretto by Jacopo Ferretti, was first performed in February 1816 following the success of Il Barbiere di Siviglia. Interestingly, much like its predecessor, the first performance of the opera was received with some hostility, but the work soon became popular throughout Italian theaters and beyond.

programme.title: Mozart Live from Beijing
programme.desc: On January 27, 2006, Chinese virtuoso pianist Lang Lang celebrated WA Mozart's birthday with a performance of the Piano Concerto No. 24 in the Forbidden City Concert Hall of Beijing with the China Philharmonic Orchestram directed by Long Yu. The concert hall is located inside the walls of the Forbidden City, in the beautifully maintained gardens of Zhongshan Park, directly adjacent to Tiananmen Square.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Mahler – Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’! Your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In this documentary, Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5.

programme.title: Dvorák - Violin Concerto in A minor, Op. 53
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19
programme.desc: From the Barockschloss in Rammenau the Gewandhaus-Quartett plays Mozart’s String Quartet No. 19 in C-major, KV. 465. This work is nicknamed 'Dissonance' due to its unusual slow introduction with dissonant notes before the harmony resolving in the key of C-major, starting the bright Allegro section.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Symphony No.1, Op. 25
programme.desc: The Easter Festival is an internationally renowned event among classical music lovers, traditionally opened in Moscow on Easter Sunday. Each year the Mariinsky Theatre Orchestra and its musical director Valery Gergiev travel across Russia - for the past 10 years now!

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Schubert - String Quartet No. 15 in G major
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Couperin - Deuxième livre, A step into the unknown
programme.desc: With her superb technique, intelligence, taste and refinement, Carole Cerasi is the dream interpreter for Couperin‘s second book, Pièces de Clavecin. More so than the first part, which is a compendium of older compositions, this volume indicates the path the composer now wished to take: style and form become more modern, and there is room for evocative mood pieces and musical portraits.

programme.title: Conducting Mahler
programme.desc: This is a beautifully shot documentary highlighting the interpretation of Mahler’s compositions by conductors Bernhard Haitink, Ricardo Chailly, Riccardo Muti, Claudio Abbado and Sir Simon Rattle. Through interviews, these conductors explain their ideas about the work of Mahler.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: Composer George Frideric Handel’s oratorio Messiah, HWV 56 is his best-known work. He wrote this choral masterpiece in just 24 days in 1741. Following its premiere in Dublin in 1742, the work has been immensely popular. The oratorio’s three parts deal with the birth, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Charles Jennens’ libretto is based on texts from the Old and New Testament.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Mozart - Mass in c minor, K. 427
programme.desc: This rendition of Mozart’s Mass in c minor, KV 427 by the Gächinger Kantorei Stuttgart, Bach-Collegium Stuttgart and conductor Helmuth Rilling is recorded at the Knights Hall in Schloss Wolfegg. Soloists are Ibolya Verebics, Andrea Rost, Uwe Heilmann and Daniel Lichti. After Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart had married Constanze Weber on the 4th of August 1782, he promised to compose a mass in her honour.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61. Leading violinist Grimal is the soloist.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach – Musical Offering in C minor
programme.desc: The Kuijken Ensemble is made up of the three Belgian Kuijken brothers on flute, violin, and viola da gamba, as well as harpsichordist Robert Kohnen. The brothers don’t look alike, but their shared musical heritage is evident. Together, The Kuijken Ensemble are among the most distinguished present-day early-music specialists.

programme.title: Schumann - Cello Concerto in A minor, Op. 129
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts Yo-Yo Ma and the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Schumann's Cello Concerto in A minor, Op. 129 from the Festspielhaus in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Beethoven Egmont Overture And Tchaikovsky Symphony 4
programme.desc: Experience a concert of high drama as conductor Nicolás Pasquet leads the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with the heroic power of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Overture to Egmont, Op. 84. The concert culminates in a journey through fate and passion with Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s monumental Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Grieg - String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: String quartet Cuarteto Mendelssohn de BP, in its 2018 configuration of violinists Olga Artyugina and Eva Rabchevska, violist Bella Chic and cellist Hayk Sukiasyan, performs Edvard Grieg’s String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27. Completed in 1878, it is the composer’s second attempt in the genre. His first string quartet, written in the early 1860s, was lost, and the third one was left incomplete at the composer’s death.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Riccardo Chailly conducts Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Riccardo Chailly’s inaugural concert as Kapellmeister of the Leipzig Gewandhaus Orchestra captures the full atmosphere of a unique musical occasion. The concert centers round composer Felix Mendelssohn, who founded the Gewandhaus Orchestra in 1743. It includes an overwhelming performance of Mendelssohn’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Balanchine
programme.desc: In this compilation of enchanting choreographies by George Balanchine, the New York City Ballet pays tribute to the man who founded the dance company in 1948 together with Lincoln Kirstein.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Liszt and Ravel
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 9, Op. 95
programme.desc: Latvian conductor Andris Nelsons leads the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95, ‘From the New World’. Dvorák wrote this famous symphony in 1893, during his three-year term as Director of the National Conservatory of Music in New York. The Conservatory had hired the nationalist composer to create a new, national style of art music for the United States.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Das Rheingold is the prologue to Richard Wagner's Ring Cycle. This rendition (2003) features the Staatsoper Stuttgart under the baton of conductor Lothar Zagrosek. Tonight’s soloists are Wolfgang Probst, Motti Kastón, Bernhard Schneider, Robert Künzli, Esa Ruuttunen, Eberhard Francesco Lorenz and Roland Bracht.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Bernhard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic and the Ernst Senff Choir in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2. This concert took place at the Berliner Philharmonie in 1992. The final chorus of Mahler's beautiful and impressive second symphony never fails to move its listeners.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Juca
programme.desc: “Juca” , apresentado por Júlio Magalhães, que chega ao ecrã de segunda a quinta-feira, entre as 21h00 e as 22h30. programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A aliança de Sig e Rick desfaz-se e Keith luta contra uma lesão e uma equipa com pouca gente. Jake perde o rumo em mares agitados.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T21 - Ep. 13

programme.title: Pesca Radical: O Regresso Do Viking T1 - Ep. 8

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 21

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como são feitos objetos como Galaktoboureko, absorvedores de dióxido de carbono e velas favo de mel?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é feito o kimchi ou os soalhos de parquet?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é feita a comida crua para cães? Ou as réplicas de luzes da polícia?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que se fazem esculturas de verga ou a torragem de café?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como são feitas as lixadoras de cilindros e as litografias?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que os calissons e os watercrafts de mergulho são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 7

programme.title: Duo De Sobreviventes T2 - Ep. 3

A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 73
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead!

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Ramón Valle And Reinier Baas - Music Meeting 2020
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. Disrupted by COVID-19, the festival’s 2020 edition had to adapt to new challenges.

programme.title: Esplanada Music And Art in Concert
programme.desc: Esplanada was brought to life by Eddy Koopman, a long time Metropol Orkest member and composer. However, unlike other leading members in musical acts along the globe, Koopman does not put emphasis on himself. Most of the music he composes are for the Rotterdam Conservatory graduate violinist Sarah Koch.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Tell Me Why
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baobap Orchestra
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: We Are Birds - La Ciotat
programme.desc: Nordic afro jazz project 'We Are Birds' saw the light between Finland and Africa, during a 2010 jam session in which Finnish jazz pianist Tuomas A. Turunen met African drummer-percussionist and urban griot Dimitri Reverchon. The two composers set their mind to exploring this hybrid genre, and found their perfect complement in bassist Emmanuel Soulignac, who brought his pop influences to the table.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Wouter Hamel Live in Paradiso
programme.desc: What Jamie Cullum is to England, Wouter Hamel is to the Netherlands: a performer who knows the difference between jazz and pop! Hamel is backed by big band Sven Happel (double bass), Jasper van Hulten (drums), Gijs Anders van Straalen (percussion), Rory Ronde (guitar), Benjamin Herman (saxophone), and a string ensemble. Hamel plays the guitar, piano, sings, and writes many of his own songs.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Anne Paceo
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Tour De Force
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Alfio Origlio
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: My favourite things
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Tokyo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Alano Gruarin Trio
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ.tv Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the Alano Gruarin Trio.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson with NHØP - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson gave a stunning performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Verônica Ferriani
programme.desc: Verônica Ferriani is a Brazilian singer and songwriter recognized for her powerful voice and distinctive musical identity. Her career spans a variety of styles within MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), and she stands out for the intensity and emotion of her performances. In her shows, Verônica presents a mix of works inspired by personal experiences, tributes to her major influences, and selections from her own compositions.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: What Is This Thing Called Love
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills.

programme.title: Rita Reys And The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009.

programme.title: Quartet No. 2 Part 2
programme.desc: Many of pianist Chick Corea’s compositions have become jazz standards. As a member of Miles Davis' band in the late 1960s, he participated in the birth of the electric jazz fusion movement. In the 1970s, Corea founded the legendary jazz fusion group Return to Forever. Along with Herbie Hancock, McCoy Tyner and Keith Jarrett, Corea is one of the biggest modern jazz pianists.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Altin Gün - BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: The group Altin Gün came to existence when bassist Jasper Verhulst made an inspiring journey to Turkey. After his show in Istanbul, he felt greatly attracted to the Turkish sound from the 1970s. With band members Ben Rider (guitar) and Nic Mauskovic (drums), he went looking for other Turkish musicians to join the band. Soon after, Merve Dasdemir (vocals) and Erdinc Yildiz Ecevit (vocals, saxophone, keys) joined the group.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jarrod Lawson
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Weather Update - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: São Paulo Samba
programme.desc: An exceptional concert from Brazil: the Orquestra Sinfônica do Estado de São Paulo proves its position as the most important orchestra in Latin America. Conducted by charismatic Maestro John Neschling since 1997, the orchestra is defined by its emblematic interpretations of Latin American music.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features 'GGG' Gennady Golovkin (23-1, 20 KOs) making his American debut defending his WBA and IBO middleweight world titles against Grzegorz 'Super G' Proska (28-1, 21 KOs).

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Floyd Mayweather, Jr., in the final bout before his first retirement from boxing, facing Ricky Hatton in a superfight. Mayweather has referred to Hatton as one of the toughest competitors he has ever had to face. Also on the card, a young Saul (Canelo) Alvarez continues to rise in the rankings.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T30 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Meisei, Tsurugisho, Kotonowaka and Tobizaru.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: This episode features a lightweight title bout between Juan Manuel Marquez and Juan Diaz, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This episode follows former UFC welterweight champion Matt Serra around his hometown in New Jersey for a look at the lighter side of this intense competitor. Ring girl Natasha Wicks shows us that the fighters aren't the only ones with the big guns. Plus a behind the scenes look at the UFC Fan Expo and an interview with MMA legend Chael Sonnen.

programme.title: FS MMA T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! From the shores of sunny Costa Rica Nick Agallar takes on Ryan Bow in a lightweight match-up. Agallar is on the comeback trail as he returns to Costa Rica to fight the 29-year-old Bow.

programme.title: Juntas And Separadas - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Enquanto Laura é silenciada no trabalho, Ana Lia se permite viver. Claudinha se envolve num amor que a fortalece e Joana insiste na carreira de atriz apesar de todos os percalços.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 60
programme.desc: O restaurante é inaugurado. Mirna segue procurando Doralice. Cristina sabota Serena em um jantar e deixa Rafael enfurecido com a futura esposa. Raul consegue um emprego na loja.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 162
programme.desc: Ferette se surpreende com presença de Zenilda, os filhos e um Oficial de Justiça com ordem de despejo. Samira manda denúncia anônima para a delegacia de Jairo. Helga confessa que matou Edilberto para proteger Arminda. Paulinho acompanha de longe a conversa entre Raul e Herculano, que pede que Joélly não procure mais pela mulher. Gerluce ajuda Lena com sua filha, sem saber que a bebê é sua neta.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 108
programme.desc: O Comendador vai tomar satisfações com Cora sobre seu diamante rosa. Reginaldo descobre segredo de Jairo. Cora chantageia o Comendador. José Alfredo confronta Enrico.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 96
programme.desc: Policiais invadem a pensão de Valentina, deixando Clara desesperada.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 49
programme.desc: ‘Orgulho e Paixão’ tem seus personagens livremente inspirados no universo da escritora inglesa Jane Austen.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Mirinho provoca Tonho. Alika conta a José que Nilo Peçanha se lembrou do tio. Fabrício chega à casa de Casemiro. Tonho revela a Casemiro que está namorando Alika/Lúcia. Mirinho e Tonho se enfrentam na fazenda. Alika/Lúcia confidencia a Salma que está se relacionando com Tonho, e pede perdão à amiga. Mirinho provoca um acidente com Tonho, e Fabrício se assusta.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Helena quer que Ana se afaste de Juca. Lucas discute com a tia. Marcelo pede a Josias para convencer Ana a vender a parte dela. Cleber recebe uma proposta de trabalho suspeita.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 138
programme.desc: João Raul confronta Naiane e Bara. Eduarda não consegue falar com Agrado, e desabafa com Zuzu sobre Leandro. Walmir pede perdão a Agrado, e afirma que a moça é o grande amor da vida de João Raul. Naiane arma um plano para retornar a sua casa, e Gael comemora. Zilá recruta Osmar para sabotar Janete e Zuzu. Ela explica como proceder para interceptar a entrega das Marias do Caturama.

programme.title: Malhação - Sonhos T22 - Ep. 268
programme.desc: Gael cai na armadilha de Lobão e fica cada vez mais desconfiado de Duca. Pedro e Karina são irresponsáveis com Tomtom perdem o paradeiro da menina.

programme.title: Viver Sertanejo - Ep. 69
programme.desc: Daniel recebe artistas de diferentes gerações do sertanejo para conversas afetivas, números musicais e tudo que combina com o modo de vida do interior, o “Viver Sertanejo”.

programme.title: Os Trapalhões - Clássicos - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O programa humorístico Os Trapalhões mostra as aventuras do quarteto atrapalhado Didi, Dedé, Mussum e Zacarias.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 56
programme.desc: Rafael fica furioso ao encontrar Serena dançando com Guto, Hélio tenta amenizar a situação e conta a verdade para o empresário. Ofélia incomoda todos na pensão.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 57
programme.desc: Rafael demostra ciúmes de Serena com Guto. Alaor ataca Olívia e Vitório culpa a moça. Marcelino se recusa a continuar com as aulas de piano. Hélio desconfia de seu pai e Eliete.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 58
programme.desc: Cristina consegue driblar os questionamentos de Rafael sobre Guto. Rafael recebe uma carta de acusação contra Abílio. Cristina pede um favor a Vera. Crispim vende Doralice.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 59
programme.desc: Vera se surpreende com a performance de Serena. Rafael demite Abílio. Jorge recebe uma carta de Vitório. Familiares e amigos se preparam para inauguração do restaurante de Olívia.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 60
programme.desc: O restaurante é inaugurado. Mirna segue procurando Doralice. Cristina sabota Serena em um jantar e deixa Rafael enfurecido com a futura esposa. Raul consegue um emprego na loja.

programme.title: Em Família Com Eliana - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Eliana visita famílias musicais famosas e comanda, no palco, uma competição musical entre famílias de telespectadores de todo o país.

programme.title: Um Suburbano Sortudo
programme.desc: A vida de Denílson muda quando ele descobre ser herdeiro de um milionário. Agora ele vai frequentar a alta sociedade e mostrar como um verdadeiro suburbano se diverte.

programme.title: Domingão Com Huck - Ep. 253
programme.desc: Apresentado por Luciano Huck, o programa leva aos brasileiros entretenimento, diversão e emoção em quadros amados pelo público, além de contar boas histórias em matérias especiais pelo país.

programme.title: A Máfia Do Apito - Ep. 3
programme.desc: À beira do colapso, Edílson recorre a substâncias para seguir apitando. Com a apuração em curso, jornalistas antecipam a denúncia e expõem o escândalo. Jogos anulados, o país em choque, mas os envolvidos saem ilesos: reflexo da impunidade brasileira.

programme.title: Copa E Cozinha - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Neste episódio de 'Copa e Cozinha', Fábio Porchat conversa com Mauro Galvão, Júnior e Ricardinho sobre convocações, os mundiais que participaram e a conquista da Copa de 2002.

programme.title: Fantástico - Ep. 2751
programme.desc: Programa em forma de revista eletrônica, o Show da Vida mistura jornalismo, denúncia, esporte, humor, dramaturgia, documentário, música e ciência.

programme.title: Altas Horas - Ep. 1270
programme.desc: Serginho Groisman promove, semanalmente, debates sobre temas relevantes com a participação da plateia, artistas e personalidades de diferentes áreas.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 157
programme.desc: Rogério ajuda Viviane a entrar no quarto de Leonardo. Leonardo e Viviane declaram amor mútuo. Arminda não encontra o celular de Edilberto que estava no cofre e a documentação que confere a propriedade das Três Graças a Rogério. Samira descobre que Lena e Herculano voltaram para o Brasil. Leonardo recebe alta e vai para a casa de Viviane. Lorena confronta Ferette.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 158
programme.desc: Paulinho conta a Gerluce que Lena pode dar pistas sobre o paradeiro da neta da cuidadora. Viviane perdoa Leo, e os dois reatam o namoro. Lucélia descobre que pegaram o dinheiro que ela havia escondido. Leonardo aceita morar com Viviane. Zenilda beija Rogério, e os dois passam a noite juntos. Gerluce comunica aos amigos que eles levarão As Três Graças de volta para a casa de Rogério.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 159
programme.desc: Juquinha e Jairo descobrem que Samira chegou ao Brasil. Ferette não atende Samira. Bagdá repreende Kasper por sofrer com saída da escultura da galeria, em vez de ir atrás de Lucélia. Joaquim revela a Paulinho e Gerluce que foi Arminda quem matou Célio. Lucélia confessa seus crimes a Maggye na presença de Júnior. Samira ameaça contar a Raul que Ferette é seu pai, caso o empresário lhe negue ajuda.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 160
programme.desc: Samira pede uma grande quantia de dinheiro a Ferette, e Arminda observa os dois sem reconhecer a mulher. Leonardo conta a Viviane que responderá ao processo sobre a Casa de Farinha em liberdade. Ferette comenta com Macedo que colocará Samira para trabalhar para ele. Chica desconfia de que, além de Helga, alguém tenha participado da morte de Célio. Arminda flagra Samira no carro com Ferette.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 161
programme.desc: Xênica fica sabendo por Macedo que Samira está no Brasil e está chantageando Ferette. Zenilda conhece a família de Juquinha. Paulinho combina com Raul a forma como ele falará com Herculano, para tentar tirar informações sobre o paradeiro da neta de Gerluce. Angélico e Leonardo se entendem. Ferette avisa a Arminda que Samira trabalhará para eles. Maggye sente medo das ameaças de Lucélia.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 162
programme.desc: Ferette se surpreende com presença de Zenilda, os filhos e um Oficial de Justiça com ordem de despejo. Samira manda denúncia anônima para a delegacia de Jairo.
